clips.title: The story
paras: Hunters and warriors gather on Hunter Rise, the southern mesa of Thunder Bluff. Its platforms give tauren hunters, trackers, skinners, and warriors room to train and prepare for battle.

Rope bridges link Hunter Rise to the neighboring bluffs of Thunder Bluff. At its center, the Hunter's Hall is where seasoned marksmen, trackers, and warriors teach the young. Practice grounds around the hall hold training dummies, weapon racks, and skinning posts. Here, tauren learn the skills needed to wield spear and bow and work hides.

Hunter Rise's people hunt across the plains of Mulgore and help defend Thunder Bluff and the wider Horde. Battlemasters stationed along the rise recruit seasoned fighters for skirmishes against Alliance incursions across contested battlegrounds. Those sworn to protect the herd gather here when the Horde needs them.
